attempts.explanation: The wire half_done is comparing div (width 8) with LAST[7:0] where LAST is defined as an integer, which causes width or sign mismatch issues in the comparison, leading div to decrement improperly or fail the half-period check.

Line 53 checks `else if (!half_done)` instead of `else if (half_done)`, which means the divider decrements every cycle except when `half_done` is reached. It should reload the divider (`div <= 8'd0`) and toggle the SPI state only when `half_done` is true, per the timing specification.

The division counter condition used `!half_done` instead of `half_done` when counting down the SCLK half-period, causing `sclk` to toggle prematurely at `div == 0` instead of waiting for `div == LAST` (i.e. `CLK_DIV` cycles).
